title: Aeneid
author: Various
content:
English-language translations of Aeneid include:


== Complete translations ==
Eneydos (1490), a translation by William Caxton
Eneados (1513), Scots translation by Gavin Douglas (transcription volumes: 1, 2, 3)
Aeneid (1697), a translation by John Dryden (transcription volumes: 1, 2)
The Æneid of Virgil (1740), a translation by Christopher Pitt
The Æneid of Virgil (1866), a translation by John Conington
The Æneid of Virgil (1908), a translation by Theodore C. Williams (transcription project)
The Aeneid of Virgil (1917), a prose translation by John Conington (transcription project)


== Partial translations ==
The Seven First Bookes of the Eneidos of Virgil converted into Englishe Meter (1558) a translation by Thomas Phaer
The nyne fyrst bookes of the Eneidos of Virgil converted into Englishe vearse by Tho. Phaer, doctour of phisike, with so muche of tenthe booke as since his death (1560) coulde be founde in unperfit papers at his house in Kilgaran Forest in Pembrokeshire (1562), edited by William Wightman
An Essay on Virgil's Æneid: Being a Translation of the First Book, by Christopher Pitt (1728)
Aeneid, Book 6, by James Elroy Flecker
